name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Mowie Wowie
description:
Bright, tropical, and full of classic flavor, Mowie Wowie brings island vibes straight to your session. Bursting with sweet pineapple and citrus-forward notes, this 3G disposable offers a smooth, uplifting experience that’s perfect for daytime enjoyment. Fresh, fruity, and easygoing, it’s a timeless strain profile built for good moods and good times.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
